title: Agent Skill Frontmatter Schema
description: JSON Schema for validating SKILL.md YAML frontmatter per agentskills.io specification

name.description: Unique skill identifier. Must match parent directory name.

description.description: What the skill does AND when to use it. Should include trigger keywords.
examples: Remove signs of AI-generated writing from text. Use when editing or reviewing text to make it sound more natural and human-written.
Format academic citations in Harvard style. Use when creating bibliographies, citing sources, or formatting references.

license.description: License name or reference to bundled LICENSE file

compatibility.description: Environment requirements (intended product, system packages, network access)
examples: Designed for Claude Code (or similar products)
Requires git, docker, jq, and access to the internet
Read Write Edit Grep Glob AskUserQuestion

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs for additional properties
